verdict.rationale: PayPal documents a first-party bulk capability in Payouts, which sends batch payments to thousands of recipients at once. That bulk support is documented only for disbursements, not for the other item types PayPal manages. The agent toolkit's inventory covers single-item tools (create_invoice, create_refund, accept_dispute_claim, etc.) with no documented batch or bulk variants, so AI-driven bulk work across invoices, disputes, products or subscriptions is unevidenced. Missing for 10: bulk operations beyond payouts (invoices, refunds, disputes, catalog, subscriptions), bulk actions exposed through the MCP server or agent toolkit, and hands-on or independent corroboration of batch behavior.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: Send money to thousands of recipients at once for vendors and disbursements in various currencies.
